statement: The ladder board reads the verdicts on disk and calls no model. GSM8K is a PARTIAL sample, 383 of 428 (89.49 percent) from bench/verdicts/public-gsm8k-partial.json, with no frontier row kept, and no published orchestrator row; HumanEval is a PARTIAL sample, 23 of 30 (76.67 percent) from bench/verdicts/public-humaneval-smoke-partial.json, decided below the frontier row o4-mini-high at 99.3, and no published orchestrator row; ARC-AGI-1 evaluation is whole, 71 of 400 (17.75 percent) from bench/verdicts/grid-evaluation.json, decided below the frontier row Gemini 3.1 Pro (Preview) at 98, and below the orchestrator row Claude Fable 5.1 (Max) at 97.5. Of 858 recorded organism answers, 8 came from the model, 400 were native and 0 were direct. The browser organism figures, 90 ns per cell run and 50 ns per packet hop, come from a log line, not a verdict file. Instances alive: 2. Multiplying: 3 instances alive at the end of the population arm after 2 duplications, its best 136/160 against the single instance at 134/160. Authored share 0.30 percent. Days since the last board: 0.217 (board 15 landed). Knowledge: simplewiki holds 284454 articles, recall@1 0.625 against null 0.09; enwiki is not measured. Bytes per score point 59660.8 at the compress bar. Improvement per wall second 0.2777 percent of the suite against his 5. Gaps open 224, 78 with a trial, 53 attempted and 1 kept in the last 7 days, 0 closed. The organism kept 0 patches per wall hour in its soak against the orchestrator's 0.0579 boards per wall hour. Board items undone 33, 1 attempted by the organism in the last 7 days, 0 kept. Climb: GSM8K board 13 partial 89.49 percent against board 11 partial 90.00 percent, undecided; HumanEval board 11 partial 76.67 percent against board 8 or earlier partial 83.33 percent, undecided, board 13 not measured; ARC-AGI-1 evaluation board 11 18.25 percent against board 10 17.75 percent, undecided, board 13 not measured. The plateau is not measured. Solved against clock is not measured and the whole-400 count is not measured. Leak-free direct recall is not measured; the swept table recalled 122 of 200 and its control 122. Board 12 multiplying is decided by tie-break noise, not a bar: builder population 133 against single 134, bar file population 136 against single 134.
how: every dated file under bench/verdicts/ladder/ is one run; the series takes the LAST run of each day. composite is the mean of the four columns, each in [0, 1]. A delta is a percent OF THE PREVIOUS DAY, not a difference in points. board is read from the verdicts on disk by node bench/ladder.mjs.
tierRule: tier N+1 unlocks when every accuracy column (answer, code, capability) of the previous day at tier N is at or above 0.9 and health is not below the day before
line: day over day: composite +6.15 percent, target 5 to 10 percent: met
